verdict.rationale: Composio is an agent tool-integration platform, so a test or sandbox environment that keeps work away from production data is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no such environment, such as test projects, mock connected accounts, or a dry-run mode. The only 'sandbox' mention is COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH, a remote Python execution sandbox for processing tool responses; it isolates code execution, not production data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
